name: dnb
eq_intent: Keep sub/kick weight controlled, remove harsh upper-mid buildup, preserve break transient detail.
compression_intent: Fast but not flattening; protect drum attack with 2:1 to 4:1 bus compression and 1 to 3 dB gain reduction.
de_esser_intent: Vocal-only where present, 5.5 to 8.5 kHz detection, max 3 dB gain reduction.
ms_eq_intent: Mono-control low side energy below 120 Hz, keep snare/vocal mid intact, reduce side harshness above 5 kHz if needed.
